title: In Vitro and In Silico DNA Binding Studies of Novel 1,2,3-Triazole-Based Coumarin Compounds.
authors: Misir, Busra Albayrak; Balli, Julide Nacaroglu; Cologlu, Tugce; Gungor, Ozge; Gungor, Seyit Ali; Kose, Muhammet
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过实验和分子对接研究新型香豆素-三唑化合物与DNA的小沟结合，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（实为小分子-DNA）且含对接方法，但对象非TF-DNA体系，方法深度有限。
abstract: Coumarin-1,2,3-triazole hybrids represent a class of compounds with significant potential in medicinal chemistry due to their versatile biological activities. In this study, a series of novel coumarin-triazole derivatives was synthesized via Cu(I)-catalyzed azide-alkyne cycloaddition. The compounds were characterized by FT-IR, (1)H/(1) (3)C NMR spectroscopy, and elemental analysis. Single-crystal x-ray analysis of compound 6 revealed a monoclinic crystal system stabilized by weak intramolecular C horizontal line H...O hydrogen bonds and pi horizontal line pi stacking interactions. DNA-binding studies, including UV-vis titration, fluorescence spectroscopy, and viscosity measurements, indicated predominant minor groove binding, with compound 6 showing the highest affinity (K(b) = 6.19 x 10(4) M(-) (1)) and favorable thermodynamic parameters. Molecular docking of compound 6 demonstrated strong binding interactions with DNA, consistent with experimental results. ADME predictions for compound 6 indicated good oral bioavailability, low toxicity, and favorable pharmacokinetic properties. These findings highlight compound 6 as a promising drug-like candidate for further biological evaluation.
abstract_zh: 香豆素-1,2,3-三唑杂合体代表了一类在药物化学中具有显著潜力的化合物，这归因于其多样的生物活性。在本研究中，通过Cu(I)催化的叠氮-炔环加成反应合成了一系列新型香豆素-三唑衍生物。这些化合物通过FT-IR、¹H/¹³C NMR光谱和元素分析进行了表征。化合物6的单晶X射线分析揭示了一个单斜晶系，该晶系通过弱的分子内C—H...O氢键和π...π堆积相互作用得以稳定。DNA结合研究，包括紫外-可见滴定、荧光光谱和粘度测量，表明其以次要沟槽结合为主，其中化合物6显示出最高的亲和力（K(b) = 6.19 x 10⁴ M⁻¹）和有利的热力学参数。化合物6的分子对接显示其与DNA有强结合相互作用，这与实验结果一致。化合物6的ADME预测表明其具有良好的口服生物利用度、低毒性和有利的药代动力学特性。这些发现突显了化合物6作为有前景的药物样候选物，值得进一步进行生物学评估。
